item.title: West Virginia State Fire Marshal urges heating safety after two fatal fires
item.description: The West Virginia State Fire Marshal's Office is sharing a warning of heating safety and carbon monoxide poisoning after two fatal fires Thursday night.

item.title: ICE arrests 3 in West Virginia; sheriff issues statement
item.description: The Marshall County Sheriff’s Office has issued a statement to address questions about recent arrests made by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents in the county.

item.title: West Virginia bill requiring bystanders to remain 30 feet from first responders passes Senate
item.description: A West Virginia bill that requires bystanders to remain at least 30 feet away from first responders while engaged in the lawful performance of their duties passed in the Senate on Thursday.

item.title: Clarksburg driver addresses concerns about propane deliveries
item.description: As temperatures in north central West Virginia remain consistently below 20 degrees, the demand for propane has skyrocketed, leading some more rural residents to have concerns about receiving their source of heat.

item.title: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection responds to transformer oil spill in Wyoming County
item.description: The West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection has responded to part of Wyoming County that experienced a transformer oil spill.

item.title: Proposed LEGO set captures iconic Pittsburgh skyline
item.description: Lego has expanded its offerings over the past few years to include more architecture-themed sets, and the Steel City might just be the latest addition.

item.title: How did West Virginia's French Creek Freddie come to be?
item.description: For 364 days out of the year, the print, television and radio media are the authority in weather forecasting for most people. But one day a year, it's all up to the groundhogs.

item.title: West Virginia resident's icy driveway video goes viral
item.description: The story of the recent winter storm that struck north central West Virginia wasn't so much about the snow accumulation, but rather the sheer amount of ice that formed across the region.

item.title: ICE arrested 650 people in West Virginia in January: Report
item.description: A new report issued by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) says that in just the month of January, the agency has arrested more than 650 people in West Virginia.

item.title: PHOTOS: Fire destroys Preston County home
item.description: A fire broke out at a home in Preston County on Friday, prompting a response from several crews.
